Name: Spore Galore
Author: HomesteadyEddy
Description:
[b]Spore Galore - Mushroom Cultivation Mod[/b]
A mushroom cultivation mod that adds realistic mechanics to Stardew Valley. Instead of Demetrius's one-time cave choice, you get a full cultivation system with actual mycology concepts - substrate types, contamination risk, multi-flush harvesting, and temperature optimization.
This is based on how mushroom cultivation actually works (I grow mushrooms IRL), so the mechanics reflect real-world substrate requirements, contamination patterns, and fruiting cycles. Made this for my wife Rose, who loves Stardew Valley.
[line][b]What This Mod Actually Does
Realistic Cultivation Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Each mushroom species requires specific substrate types (straw, sawdust, hardwood logs, pine logs)
[*]Multi-flush harvesting: substrates produce 2-5 harvests over multiple weeks, yielding 1-3 mushrooms per flush
[*]Contamination is checked once at inoculation - sterilization is optional (0% vs 30% risk)
[*]Temperature and location affect growth speed (basement bonus for Enoki, outdoor seasonal modifiers)
[*]Matsutake requires pine trees nearby and has 65% contamination even when sterilized
[/list][b]The Cultivation Cycle:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Craft substrate (7 types available, recipes unlock via quests)
[*]Optionally sterilize it (safe but slower) or skip sterilization (risky but faster)
[*]Propagate liquid culture in Culture Incubator (works like Crystallarium)
[*]Inoculate substrate with culture
[*]Wait 7-18 days depending on species
[*]Harvest 1-3 mushrooms, wait 3-7 days, harvest again (repeat 2-5 times per substrate)
[*]Compost spent substrate into fertilizer
[/list]Nothing revolutionary - just a complete system that follows actual mushroom biology.
[line][b]Species & Progression[/b]
[b]8 Cultivatable Mushrooms:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Oyster[/b] (Level 0): Beginner-friendly, 7 days to first flush, 5 harvests, 56g each
[*][b]Enoki[/b] (Level 0): Cold-preferring, grows 25% faster in winter/basement, 69g each
[*][b]Turkey Tail[/b] (Level 0): Medicinal, consecutive consumption buff (+1 Speed, +40 Max Energy permanent), 81g each
[*][b]King Oyster[/b] (Level 4): Requires supplemented substrate, 94g each
[*][b]Lion's Mane[/b] (Level 4): Medicinal/cognitive benefits, 113g each
[*][b]Shiitake[/b] (Level 4): Traditional log cultivation, 5 flushes, 75g each
[*][b]Maitake[/b] (Level 7): Expensive substrate, long growth time, 131g each
[*][b]Matsutake[/b] (Level 10): Endgame challenge - 1,100g per mushroom but 65-80% contamination rate
[/list][b]3 Wild-Only Species:[/b]
[list]
[*]Chicken of the Woods (500g), Giant Puffball (375g), Black Trumpet (750g)
[*]Seasonal spawns with 3x rate day after rain
[/list][b]20 Rare Mutations:[/b]
[list]
[*]0.75% chance per mushroom to discover variants (2% with power book)
[*]Variants sell for 15-50% premium and get +3 bonus harvests when cultivated
[*]Examples: Pink Oyster (80g), Golden Lion's Mane (196g), Pure White Matsutake (1,600g)
[/list][line][b]Machines & Processing[/b]
[b]7 Custom Machines:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Substrate Mixer[/b]: Decorative (substrates craft anywhere via normal menu)
[*][b]Sterilizer[/b]: 0% contamination, 2-4 hours + coal
[*][b]Culture Incubator[/b]: Continuous liquid culture production (10 days first batch, 4 days subsequent), auto-outputs to chests
[*][b]Mushroom Dryer[/b]: 5 mushrooms → 1 dried mushroom (6x value), 2 hours
[*][b]Tincture Brewery[/b]: 2 dried mushrooms + 1 mead → medicinal tincture, 5 days, high-value buffs
[*][b]Composting Bin[/b]: Spent/contaminated substrate → mushroom compost (fertilizer)
[*][b]Mealworm Bin[/b]: Produces mealworms (bait/chicken feed) and frass (fertilizer)
[/list]All machines compatible with Automate via PFMAutomate.
[line][b]Quest Chain & Power Books
"The Mycelium Method" - 7 Educational Quests:
[/b]Given by Demetrius. Teaches the full cultivation cycle, introduces contamination mechanics, unlocks substrate recipes and machine recipes. Quest 7 is the Matsutake mastery challenge.
[b]3 Permanent Upgrade Books:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]The Forager's Handbook[/b]: +1 mushroom per flush forever (33-50% yield increase)
[*][b]Sterile Techniques[/b]: -10% contamination (50,000g from Robin)
[*][b]Mushroom Foraging Book[/b]: 0.75% → 2% mutation rate
[/list][line][b]Unintended Feature List (AKA Known Bugs)
[/b]Mealworms can be fed to chickens any amount of times - INSTANT FRIENDSHIP BOOST!
Sometimes in multiplayer, other players can't get in their door - TROLL YOUR FRIENDS!
Rain foraging bonus doesn't apply if you log out after saving on a rainy day - LOSE YOUR BONUS SHROOMS!
Substrate mixer is cosmetic only for the time being - CRAFT SUSBTRATE ANYWHERE!?
Sometimes placement tries to place it directly in front of you if you're too far from the placement location - IT'S... a dead joke, I'll stop

[line][b]Technical Details[/b]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+
[*]Producer Framework Mod (required)
[*]Automate + PFMAutomate (optional, for machine automation)
[*]UI Info Suite 2 (optional, shows processing times)
[/list][b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]108+ custom items
[*]31 mushroom types (11 base + 20 variants)
[*]7 machines via Producer Framework Mod
[*]Full multiplayer support (host needs mod installed)
[*]Automate compatibility for substrate auto-harvesting
[*]~11,500 lines of C# code
[/list][b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]Works with most content mods
[*]May conflict with other mushroom cultivation mods
[*]Fully multiplayer compatible
[/list][line]Installation[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Producer Framework Mod
[*]Download and extract Spore Galore
[*]Copy both [code]SporeGalore[/code] and [code][PFM]SporeGalore[/code] folders to [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]
[*]Launch via SMAPI
[/list][b]Quick Start:[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy Oyster Culture from Pierre (150g)
[*]Complete Quest 1: "First Flush" to unlock substrate recipes
[*]Craft Straw Substrate (1 Hay)
[*]Optionally sterilize it or risk 30% contamination
[*]Inoculate with culture, wait 7 days, harvest
[/list]Debug command [code]sg_teach_recipes[/code] unlocks all recipes immediately for testing.
[line]Credits
[b]HomesteadyEddy[/b] - Development, design, real-world mycology knowledge
[b]Rose[/b] - Inspiration and playtesting
[b]Paradigmnomad[/b] - Producer Framework Mod
[b]Pathoschild[/b] - SMAPI and Automate
[b]ConcernedApe[/b] - Stardew Valley
[line]Substrate types, contamination patterns, and multi-flush mechanics are based on actual mushroom cultivation. Matsutake's difficulty reflects real-world cultivation challenges. If you're into farming mods with depth and don't mind some failures along the way, this might be for you.
